shellCommands.command: cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -20 && echo "=== cache exports ===" && cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -40 && echo "=== cache.d.ts ===" && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cat app/page.tsx && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "=== eval dir ===" && ls -la __agent_eval__ && cat __agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null | head -60
grep -n "refresh" node_modules/next/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== full refresh impl ==="; grep -n "function refresh" -A 40 node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js
grep -n "connection" node_modules/next/server.d.ts | head; echo "=== server.js exports ==="; grep -n "connection\|export" node_modules/next/server.js | head -20

(timeout 120 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o "Notifications are <strong>[^<]*" ; echo "---"; grep -ro '"[0-9a-f]\{40\}"' .next/server/app/page.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
ls .next/server/ | head -20; echo "=== action manifest ==="; cat .next/server/server-reference-manifest.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 1500

ACTION=0026197fd6471a64301411b1bda9f08808a941dc31
echo "=== POST action (invoke toggle) ==="
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3111/ \
  -H "Next-Action: $ACTION" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \
  --data '[]' -o /tmp/action.txt -w "HTTP=%{http_code}\n"
echo "=== status/redirect headers ==="
grep -iE "^(HTTP/|x-action-redirect|location|x-nextjs-redirect)" /tmp/action.txt || echo "(no redirect headers)"
echo "=== does response carry refreshed page data? ==="
grep -c "Notifications are" /tmp/action.txt
grep -o "Notifications are.\{0,60\}" /tmp/action.txt | head -3

ACTION=0026197fd6471a64301411b1bda9f08808a941dc31
echo "GET after toggle:"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o "Notifications are <strong>[^<]*"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -H "Next-Action: $ACTION" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data '[]' > /dev/null
echo "GET after 2nd toggle:"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o "Notifications are <strong>[^<]*"
